A Small Gesture, A Lasting Memory at Le Club Ba
Sep 2026 • Friends
Le Club Bar was undoubtedly one of the highlights of my stay at Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi. 
The atmosphere was elegant and relaxed, but what made the experience truly special was the warmth and attentiveness of the staff. Every interaction felt natural, sincere, and thoughtful rather than simply formal or procedural.
One moment in particular left a lasting impression. While having breakfast at Le Club Bar, I casually asked whether the hotel’s 125th anniversary pin was available for purchase. Mrs. Anh later surprised me with the pin as a gift, together with a handwritten note.
It was a small gesture, but an exceptionally meaningful one. In my experience, genuine luxury is often found in these thoughtful details — when a hotel goes beyond simply providing good service and creates a personal memory for its guests.
The service at Le Club Bar reflected exactly that kind of hospitality. It was warm, refined, and genuinely memorable.
My sincere compliments to Mrs. Anh and the entire Le Club Bar team for making this such a special experience.
Read more
Insider tip:
Come for the elegant atmosphere, but stay for the exceptionally warm and thoughtful service.
